$comment: The two ad-page folds with NO Figma component. They exist only as built HTML in
web/internal/staging/ai-crm-lander, so the shipped page is their source of truth and
their provenance is BUILT-HERE, not measured-from-Figma. This is the case the 15 Sep
ruling is actually about: work created here, which has to be measured and passed
HOW THESE WERE MEASURED. The page was rendered and computed styles were harvested off
the two sections, located by the page's own section comments rather than by a class
name — so the boundary is the page's, not one I chose. Distinct values were then
checked against foundation/tokens.css. A count is how many elements resolved to that
value, not how many times someone typed it.
A FINDING HERE IS NOT A BUG IN THE PAGE. It is a value the page uses that the system
has no token for. Either the token should exist, or the page should change. Both are
rulings, and neither is made here.
method: rendered page, computed styles, checked against tokens.css

findings.why: The display ramp is 60/56/44/38/32/26/22 — there is no 18px step. It is also Bold, and only h1-h4 are 700 (h5/h6 are 600, h7 is 500). So an 18px Bold display style is off the ramp twice over. 54 uses is every agent card title.
Not in any ramp. The nearest steps are neutral-35 (#f5f5f5) and neutral-50 (#f1f2f3); it sits between them and matches neither.
The body ramp at 16px is reg 400, med 500, sem 600. There is no 700. 17 uses — the whole first column of the table.
The spacing scale has neither 1 nor 6. tokens.css is explicit that the scale is irregular and must not be interpolated.
